crossRefs.note: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
Shall not his majesty make you afraid, and his dread fall on you?
Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.

translations.web: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
translations.bsb: Withdraw Your hand from me, and do not let Your terror frighten me.
translations.kjv: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
translations.asv: Withdraw thy hand far from me; And let not thy terror make me afraid.
